News / TradingView / Key facts: Eli Lilly posts $23B quarter; Foundayo approved, $50 copay

Key facts: Eli Lilly posts $23B quarter; Foundayo approved, $50 copay Less than 1 min read

LLY Eli Lilly (LLY) posted $23.0B quarterly revenue, up 48% year-over-year. Volumes rose 60% while realized prices fell 13%. Mounjaro and Zepbound drove about $14.9B of sales. GuruFocus Eli Lilly (LLY) won April 2026 approval for Foundayo, its oral GLP‑1 therapy, marking market authorization for the company’s oral GLP‑1 product. Benzinga Medicare’s 2025 policy sets a $50 copay for approved injectable and oral GLP-1s. Eli Lilly’s oral GLP-1 Foundayo is included among drugs subject to the $50 copay. Benzinga Eli Lilly (LLY) reported Phase 1 ESMO 2026 data for its FRα-targeting ADC in platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer: objective response rate 79%, disease control rate 100%. Reuters Eli Lilly (LLY) GLP‑1 drug Mounjaro linked to higher consumer demand for high‑protein foods; surveys show users plan about 11% higher spending to offset potential GLP‑1–related muscle loss Reuters Eli Lilly (LLY) shares fell about 1.7% in premarket trading ahead of its earnings release as traders positioned for results and pricing impact on profit. Key facts: SU buys PTC €20bn; data-center orders up; Vienne closure Less than 1 min read

SU Schneider Electric (SU) plans to buy US software firm PTC for over €20 billion to add PTC’s digital tools and AI to Schneider’s industrial products; it’s Schneider’s biggest-ever deal. AFP Schneider Electric (SU) reports strong data‑center orders and sustained bookings for power, cooling and automation gear, driven by US hyperscalers and growth led by China and East Asia. Reuters Schneider Electric (SU) plans to close its Vienne plant, cutting 160 jobs, and consolidate operations in Eure. The restructuring will be supported by a €150 million investment.
